functions.name: central_function
functions.description: Region set enrichment (LOLA) of the DMRs of a DMP/DMR result against LOLACore hg38, with the probes tested by DMP/DMR as universe. Computed once, on one node; no patient data is used.

arguments.name: input_source
arguments.description: 'Result of a previous task': this run uses the result of the task you give below. 'Upload my own files': upload a JSON file instead, e.g. for different data.

arguments.name: dmp_task_id
arguments.description: Id of a finished DMP/DMR task (2.1.0 or later), shown on its task page: this run uses its DMRs and its tested probes (universe) Leave empty to use the most recent finished DMP/DMR task of this session; the result's Input table shows which one was used.

arguments.name: dmrs
arguments.description: The global_dmrs of a DMP/DMR result (chromosome, start, end per DMR)

arguments.name: universe
arguments.description: The universe of the same DMP/DMR result: the probes it tested (chromosome, position)

arguments.name: collections
arguments.description: Collections to test: ucsc_features, encode_tfbs, sheffield_dnase, codex, cistrome_cistrome, cistrome_epigenome (default: all).

arguments.name: direction
arguments.description: enrichment (default) or depletion: the one-sided Fisher test.

arguments.name: min_overlap
arguments.description: Minimum overlap between a CpG and a reference region.

arguments.name: top_n
arguments.description: Number of region sets returned, smallest p-value first (1 to 10,000).

ui_visualizations.name: Input
ui_visualizations.description: Where this run's input came from

ui_visualizations.name: Enriched region sets
ui_visualizations.description: LOLACore region sets, smallest p-value first
